curve_kind: Distance-bin median NK surface section and pooled 200-query CFD reference

timing_comparison.statistic: Calibrated distance-bin median-residual surface section; not the displayed individual flow case clock

population_statistics.statistic: Median of per-case first recorded target times over all 200 cases; failed cases have infinite hitting time
population_statistics.clock: cumulative solver time, plus 0.04 s prediction for full

native_flow_mapping: Native elapsed-time progress mapped to the duration of the corresponding statistical median section; raw pressure interpolated between captured solver states.

surface_audit.render_changes: Recomputed from current maintained NK correction Random200 history; original statistical surface drawing and camera retained.

native_error_replay: Signed Cp error from the same-case converged CFD reference; native signed pressure differences interpolate before conversion and colouring.
trajectory_replay: The active distance-bin surface section grows with the same normalized native elapsed-time progress used by the NK error lens; incoming/outgoing sections crossfade during case handoff.

geometry_placement.centering: midpoint of the full neighbouring upper-edge extent
geometry_placement.leaders: connect each geometry to its original OOD position

correction_arrows: Both NK arrows extend with the same normalized residual decrease on the active calibrated section.

error.title: Cp error, ΔCp
error.definition: Current Cp minus same-case converged CFD Cp

legend_layout.statistics_transition: Follows the same eased camera progress; no delayed CSS animation

left_view_layout.alignment: complete left plot including geometry rail and axes is centred vertically with the complete right field/annotation/colorbar group
